newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to address parliament on March 5.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to address parliament on March 5.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will make his annual address to Russia's two chambers of parliament on March 5, Yegor Stroyev, chairman of the Federation Council upper house, said on Thursday.

Yeltsin is currently recovering from pneumonia at a country residence outside Moscow. His political opponents say his performance before lawmakers when he gives his address will reveal more clearly how fit he still is to run the country.
Yeltsin, 66, went down with pneumonia only two weeks after returning to the Kremlin after recovering from open heart surgery on November 5.

The Kremlin could not initially comment on the March 5 date given by Stroyev for Yeltsin's address. Aides had earlier said Yeltsin would speak to parliament in February, possibly as early as February 21.
